$comment: Universal MCP server definitions — GitHub personal (adineo-cmd) + work (adineo-cmd2) accounts. Same wrapper scripts are wired into every agent. To rotate a token, replace the file in ~/.config/mcp/secrets/ — no config edits needed. This file uses the standard mcpServers schema (Claude Code / Cursor / Windsurf shape) and serves as the reference copy for wiring up new agents.
